_meta.source: TB_AI_Audit_Final_Detailed_Team_Final.md Appendix C (account -> assertion -> response quick map), Appendix B (evidence-request catalogue), sec 9 (account-area analytical library), sec 13.1 (evidence request discipline)
_meta.purpose: Maps an ACCOUNT AREA to the assertions it exposes and the exact records that resolve them.
_meta.replaces: backend/tools/risk/build_exception_consolidator.py's source-engine-derived mapping, which assigned assertions by WHICH ENGINE FIRED rather than by what the account is: anything risk-sourced became Accuracy+Valuation with evidence 'Ledgers'; anything sensitive became Classification+Presentation+Rights with 'Contracts/Agreements'; variance became 'Reconciliations'; validation became 'Mapping Review'. Appendix C requires the opposite direction, and sec 13.1 explicitly forbids generic requests of exactly that shape.
_meta.amend_policy: Evidence entries must name a SPECIFIC record ('party-wise debtors ageing', 'GSTR-3B for the period') and never a generic category ('supporting documents', 'ledgers'). Each area's evidence should be sufficient to resolve at least one of its listed assertions -- sec 13.1 requires linking each record to the assertion it settles.
_meta.matching: case_insensitive_substring against FSLI / main_head / sub_head_1, then gl_name; sensitive-tag entries match the tag emitted by build_sensitive_detector

evidence: Cut-off testing either side of the period end
Segregation of grant and subsidy income from operating revenue
revenue.primary_objective: Verify that recorded revenue occurred, is complete, and falls in the correct period.

evidence: Party-wise debtors ageing in Schedule III format
Subsequent receipts after the period end
Customer ledger for accounts with credit balances
trade_receivables.primary_objective: Verify that receivables exist, are owned, and are carried at recoverable value.

evidence: Bank reconciliation statements at the period end
Complete list of bank accounts including dormant ones
Board approvals for account opening and closing
Identification of earmarked or restricted balances
cash_and_bank.primary_objective: Verify existence and unrestricted availability of cash and bank balances.

evidence: Stock records and physical verification report
Inventory valuation working with cost basis
Stock ageing and slow / non-moving analysis
Third-party stock confirmations for goods held elsewhere
inventory.primary_objective: Verify physical existence and carrying value of inventory.

evidence: Fixed asset register reconciled to the general ledger
Depreciation working by asset class with useful lives
Revaluation working and valuer's report where applicable
ppe_depreciation.primary_objective: Verify existence, ownership and carrying value of the asset base.

evidence: CWIP ageing schedule in Schedule III format
Project-wise status and physical progress reports
Work completion certificates and contractor invoices
Capitalisation policy and trigger for transfer to PPE
Approvals and sanctions for the project
Impairment assessment for stalled or overdue projects
cwip_capital_advances.primary_objective: Verify that costs carried in CWIP relate to live projects and are capitalised at the right time.

evidence: Investee financial statements or net-worth statement
Board approvals for acquisition and disposal
investments.primary_objective: Verify existence, ownership and carrying value of investments.

evidence: Party-wise ageing of advances and deposits
Sanction orders and delegation of powers
loans_advances_deposits.primary_objective: Verify existence, recoverability and authorisation of advances and deposits.

evidence: Payables ageing in Schedule III format
Subsequent payments after the period end
Delayed-payment interest computation under the MSMED Act
Purchase cut-off testing and GR/IR reconciliation
Vendor ledger for accounts with debit balances
trade_payables_msme.primary_objective: Search for unrecorded liabilities and verify that recorded payables are genuine obligations.

borrowings_finance_cost.primary_objective: Verify completeness of borrowings and the related finance cost.

evidence: PF, ESI and professional tax challans and returns
TDS returns and challans with due-date ageing
Actuarial valuation for gratuity and leave encashment
Assessment and demand orders, and the disputed-dues schedule
payroll_statutory_dues.primary_objective: Verify completeness of employee costs and statutory liabilities.

evidence: Legal counsel and tax consultant confirmations
Approval trail for provisions raised and reversed
provisions_contingencies.primary_objective: Verify completeness and measurement of provisions and disclosure of contingencies.

evidence: Sanction order with the full text of grant conditions
Fund-utilisation statement and project expenditure statement
Bank trail for receipt and application of funds
Unspent funds schedule and treatment of interest earned
grants_subsidies.primary_objective: Verify classification, purpose-compliance and utilisation of grant funds.

evidence: Transaction listing and journal dump for the account
Name of the department responsible for clearance
Approval trail for entries pending resolution
suspense_clearing.primary_objective: Establish what the balance consists of and why it remains unresolved.

equity_reserves.primary_objective: Verify the validity and classification of equity and reserve movements.

evidence: Chart of accounts with the entity's own FSLI mapping
Account-wise ledger extract for the period
Management explanation of the account's purpose
unclassified.primary_objective: Establish what the account represents before assessing any assertion.
unclassified.note: Fallback for accounts with no reliable mapping. Per sec 1.2 the model must NOT force a mapping -- these are information requests, not audit findings.

sensitive_tag_overrides._note: Where an account carries a sensitive tag from build_sensitive_detector, these assertions and evidence are ADDED to whatever its account area already requires. sec 5.4 treats these as material by nature or context regardless of value.

evidence: Board and shareholder approvals for related-party transactions
Underlying agreements with arm's-length basis documented
Competent sanction for the write-off, waiver or ex-gratia
Written justification and supporting case file
Section 135 computation of the CSR obligation
Unspent CSR working and transfer evidence to the specified account
MSME vendor declarations with Udyam registration
Nature and origin period of the item
Subsequent payment evidence after the period end
